notes:
- Packs & Shaders has a Gallery tab: texture packs other Iris Client players published, installed with one press.
- Publish your own with UPLOAD A PACK. Give it a name and a line about what it is, and everyone on the client can install it. You can take it down again at any time, and only you can.
- A pack can be up to 60 MB. It goes up in pieces and comes back down from the same place the launcher gets its updates, so a large pack is not a problem.
- What comes down is checked against what was published before it is written, so a pack that was tampered with is refused rather than installed.
